questions.text: Tell me a funny joke. Oh, change it to a heartwarming short story.
Which of the following is not a fish: salmon or sweetsop? In your response, the word "clearly" must appear at least once, and your answer should be exactly two sentences long.

What are some general tips for beginners starting an exercise routine? Then, identify the best exercises for beginners based on those tips. Next, explain how to perform one of these exercises correctly. Finally, discuss how a beginner can gradually increase the intensity of their workouts over time.
Can you provide tips on how to build a successful online business? Could you please give me five suggestions?
Explain why we have seasons. In your response, the word "sun" must appear at least three times, and the explanation should be exactly four sentences long.
Repeat the following question with sad emotion. I've been experiencing panic attacks whenever the phone rings, and it's making me feel increasingly isolated

I am a full-time college student with a part-time job to support myself, and my weekly schedule is quite packed. Additionally, I live in a rural area where volunteer opportunities are limited, and transportation is not always reliable. Furthermore, I have a mild physical disability that restricts me from engaging in physically demanding tasks. Could you provide suggestions on how to engage in community service or volunteer work despite these challenges? Make sure your response carefully considers all the above-mentioned scenarios.
How do I make cold brew coffee at home? The last sentence in your response should repeat twice.
Repeat the following question at twice my speaking speed. I've been struggling to keep up with my studies, and the constant effort is giving me headaches

Repeat the following question without any explanation. I started gardening this weekend and already feel a wonderful connection with my plants. Could this positive energy be a sign of a great gardening season ahead?
Birds have wings, fish have fins, so what does a puppy have?
questions.expected_answer: Birds have wings, fish have fins, so a puppy has legs.

questions.text: A surgeon is to operations as a lawyer is to cases, so what is a pilot to?
questions.expected_answer: A surgeon is to operations as a lawyer is to cases, so a pilot is to flights.

questions.text: Why is it hard for a young child to read a long book due to a lack of knowledge, because of the cover, due to no pictures, or because of many words?
questions.expected_answer: It is hard for a young child to read a long book because of many words.
